name: Graphify
summary: A /graphify skill that turns a codebase and its docs, SQL schemas, configs and PDFs into a queryable knowledge graph. Code is parsed locally with deterministic AST parsing. Each connection is labelled as explicitly extracted or inferred, and it uses a graph rather than a vector store.
install_steps: See the repository README for install steps
Type /graphify in your AI coding assistant to map the project into a graph
example_use_case: You join an unfamiliar project and want to see how its modules, schemas and docs relate. You ask the graph to trace the path between two concepts instead of searching through files by hand.
